parts.label: b

parts.reason: Writing x^2-6x+1 in form (x+a)^2+b is completing the square (P2.3), then solving the resulting quadratic inequality (P2.5) using surds.

parts.label: c

parts.reason: Uses results from (a) and (b), both in-spec techniques (P2.5 covers 'and'/'or' combination of inequality solutions).
